correctness.rationale: Reconstructed full face count (3q,3q²,2q²) and two triangles per edge. The coset of each of the first two coordinates in A/<d> partitions triangles into precisely g² connected edge-disjoint components; each has three h-element color classes, vertex links a single 2h-cycle, coherent orientations of alternating levels and χ=3h−h². Hence each is an orientable closed surface of genus (h−1)(h−2)/2. Different pieces intersect only at vertices; their bipartite vertex-surface incidence graph has 3gq edges, g²+3q nodes and is connected, so its free cycle rank is (g−1)(3q−g−1). Replacing vertex identifications by contractible stars and collapsing a spanning tree yields the stated wedge and torsion-free integral homology. Independent reconstruction directly enumerated triangle edge-adjacency and local links for cyclic (q,d)=(6,2),(6,3),(8,2),(12,4) and confirmed all predicted piece/link counts. Infinite statement follows from coset and surface argument, not finite tests.

final_claim: For finite abelian A, d≠0 of order h and index g=|A|/h≥2, the three-color two-level sum complex is homotopy equivalent to a wedge of g² orientable surfaces of genus (h−1)(h−2)/2 and (g−1)(3|A|−g−1) circles; integral H2 has rank g² and integral H1 has rank |A|²−3|A|+1+g².
